deliverable: One minimal test-only Kiota patch using the two exact retained files, passing focused and complete current tests, plus an indexed local PR draft; otherwise an exact duplicate/no-value or bounded incompatibility result.
must_preserve: Control and candidate fixture bytes and SHA-256 identities are unchanged
The candidate must bind TcError::Reject and the exact owner-list/index message
orphan-ctor remains coverage of the separate missing-owner branch
No checker, proof, mutation, export generator, new export bytes or external research write
No current-defect, universal metadata authority, soundness or maintainer-capacity claim
repair_policy: An ordinary test or Lab tooling failure remains inside this item. Preserve raw failure evidence and charged reservations; repair only test or Lab tooling within the fixed source/fixture design and remaining budget. Production-code change or scientific-input change stops the item.
prelaunch: One owner commits exact patch, fixture hashes, expected cells/test names/counts, Cargo/dependency/toolchain lock, invocations, sequential reservations, timeouts, process-group cleanup and accounting before the first process.
closure: Run affected validators and the complete current/historical Lab suite, refresh generated state, update the external-contribution ledger and local PR draft, compare project-wide alternatives, select one READY successor without starting it, commit and push main, then stop.
